d:
CJP co-convenor Sourav Das has alleged that his passport details have been leaked, and he has held individuals associated with the BJP responsible for this. On social media, many people are sharing images of his passport and trolling him over the fact that his father’s name is not mentioned in it. However, according to the rules, it is possible to obtain a passport by providing the name of only one parent. Meanwhile, Sourav Das has stated that he intends to file a complaint against the social media handles that are circulating his leaked passport details.
